exact_statement: For every odd prime d and every positive self-adjoint Weyl-conjugation-invariant Q on the real traceless-Hermitian space, the full barycenter-constrained canonical-EB support equals max over pure states of f_Q(P), equivalently max_psi 2 sum_[g] q_[g] |<psi,W_g psi>|^2. The proof uses convexity for the upper bound and the d^2-element Weyl orbit 1-design of a maximizing pure state for the lower bound.

This bounds every symmetric CP extension; no covariance or HS-positivity assumption on the bounded channel is used.

exact_statement: For odd-prime d and Weyl-invariant positive self-adjoint Q, the top eigenvalue of H_Q is attained by a symmetric two-output CPTP broadcaster whose marginal is unital, Weyl-covariant, and Hilbert-Schmidt self-adjoint. The construction does not ensure Hilbert-Schmidt positivity; this is a separate transfer-sign gate.
